name: Sheri Biggs
bio: a Representative from South Carolina; born in Mississippi, March 28, 1970; graduated from Kosciusko High School, Kosciusko, Miss., 1988; graduated from Carolina Bible College, Anderson, S.C.; D.N.P., Samford University, Homewood, Ala.; Mississippi Air National Guard; nurse practitioner; nursing home administrator; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 03, 2025 – present).
